posts.what: Now and then Lumi lies in the grass with a few friends while a cloud above gathers into a heart, fish and pig, each shouted out by a friend; shown as one traced still of the heart over the treetops.
posts.recipe: occasional island event: Lumi and a few friends gather, a small sequence plays, they shout, it ends
posts.shared: Lumi plus a few nearby friends gather for a brief ambient moment with one-liners, then disperse

posts.what: The visitor's browser mouse pointer becomes a moth over the island; friends chase and leap for it, sulk if it goes over the sea, and it lands on Lumi if held still.
posts.recipe: viewer-controlled pointer object that friends react to
posts.shared: the browser visitor affects the island and friends react

posts.what: A film of the first failed take of the moth: friends stand still while the moth flies round their noses because their notice timer was late.
posts.recipe: film of a failed take of the moth feature
posts.shared: a post about a failed attempt at a feature, shown as a picture/film of the failure
